page.overview:
Who is Drekkit?

Drekkit was one of the leaders of a goblin clan that lived in the Marrow Valley.

Drekkit was a goblin man with green skin who wore armor and a hood adorned with a small metal skull, and wielded an axe. Only his right eye, was visible, the left was covered by a bandage, suggesting an injurie or the lack of the eye.

At some point around 833 PD Drekkit and his mate, Khaaz, led their goblin clan to Felderwin, attacking their inhabitants and taking several prisoners, including Veth and Yeza Brenatto, as well as their young son, Luc.

The clan kept the prisoners for weeks, weaker and weaker, until the halfling family was able to escape, using bone toothpicks that Khaaz had left within reach to force the lock on their cage. While Yeza and Luc ran ahead, Veth lured their captors away, eventually being confronted by them. She tried to attack them (Drekkit catched the crossbow bolt she fired at him), and ended up throwing a vial of acid in the leader's face, killing him. Khaaz witnessed it, and once Veth was recaptured, the goblin widow used the help of a witch, Isharnai, to torture Drekkit's killer.
